class NumberWordFormatter:
    NUMBER_EMPTY = ""
    NUMBER_ONE = "ONE"
    NUMBER_TWO = "TWO"
    NUMBER_THREE = "THREE"
    NUMBER_FOUR = "FOUR"
    NUMBER_FIVE = "FIVE"
    NUMBER_SIX = "SIX"
    NUMBER_SEVEN = "SEVEN"
    NUMBER_EIGHT = "EIGHT"
    NUMBER_NINE = "NINE"
    NUMBER_TEN = "TEN"
    NUMBER_ELEVEN = "ELEVEN"
    NUMBER_TWELVE = "TWELVE"
    NUMBER_THIRTEEN = "THIRTEEN"
    NUMBER_FOURTEEN = "FOURTEEN"
    NUMBER_FIFTEEN = "FIFTEEN"
    NUMBER_SIXTEEN = "SIXTEEN"
    NUMBER_SEVENTEEN = "SEVENTEEN"
    NUMBER_EIGHTEEN = "EIGHTEEN"
    NUMBER_NINETEEN = "NINETEEN"
    NUMBER_TWENTY = "TWENTY"
    NUMBER_THIRTY = "THIRTY"
    NUMBER_FORTY = "FORTY"
    NUMBER_FIFTY = "FIFTY"
    NUMBER_SIXTY = "SIXTY"
    NUMBER_SEVENTY = "SEVENTY"
    NUMBER_EIGHTY = "EIGHTY"
    NUMBER_NINETY = "NINETY"
    NUMBER_MORE_EMPTY = ""
    NUMBER_THOUSAND = "THOUSAND"
    NUMBER_MILLION = "MILLION"
    NUMBER_BILLION = "BILLION"
    
    NUMBER_WORDS = [
        NUMBER_EMPTY, NUMBER_ONE, NUMBER_TWO, NUMBER_THREE, NUMBER_FOUR,
        NUMBER_FIVE, NUMBER_SIX, NUMBER_SEVEN, NUMBER_EIGHT, NUMBER_NINE
    ]
    
    NUMBER_TEEN_WORDS = [
        NUMBER_TEN, NUMBER_ELEVEN, NUMBER_TWELVE, NUMBER_THIRTEEN, NUMBER_FOURTEEN,
        NUMBER_FIFTEEN, NUMBER_SIXTEEN, NUMBER_SEVENTEEN, NUMBER_EIGHTEEN, NUMBER_NINETEEN
    ]
    
    NUMBER_TEN_WORDS = [
        NUMBER_TEN, NUMBER_TWENTY, NUMBER_THIRTY, NUMBER_FORTY, NUMBER_FIFTY,
        NUMBER_SIXTY, NUMBER_SEVENTY, NUMBER_EIGHTY, NUMBER_NINETY
    ]
    
    NUMBER_MORE_WORDS = [
        NUMBER_MORE_EMPTY, NUMBER_THOUSAND, NUMBER_MILLION, NUMBER_BILLION
    ]
    
    SUFFIX_EMPTY = ""
    SUFFIX_K = "k"
    SUFFIX_W = "w"
    SUFFIX_M = "m"
    SUFFIX_B = "b"
    SUFFIX_T = "t"
    SUFFIX_P = "p"
    SUFFIX_E = "e"
    
    NUMBER_SUFFIX_WORDS = [
        SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_K, SUFFIX_W, SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_M,
        SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_B, SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_T,
        SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_P, SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_EMPTY, SUFFIX_E
    ]
    
    ZERO_ONLY = "ZERO ONLY"
    ONLY = "ONLY"
    AND_CENTS = "AND CENTS"
    HUNDRED = "HUNDRED"
    AND = "AND"
    SPACE = " "
    ZERO = "0"
    ZERO00 = "000"
    ZERO0 = "00"
    ZERO_SINGLE = "0"
    ONE = "1"
    TWO = "2"
    
    def __init__(self):
        pass
    
    def format(self, x):
        if x is None:
            return self.SUFFIX_EMPTY
        return self.format_string(str(x))
    
    def format_string(self, x):
        lstr, rstr = (x.split('.') + [''])[:2]
        lstrrev = self._reverse_and_pad(lstr)
        a = self._extract_thousands_groups(lstrrev)
        lm = self._format_thousands(a)
        xs = self._format_cents(rstr)
        lm_stripped = lm.strip()
        if not lm_stripped:
            return self.ZERO_ONLY
        return self.format_with_cents(lm_stripped, xs)
    
    def _reverse_and_pad(self, lstr):
        lstrrev = lstr[::-1]
        remainder = len(lstrrev) % 3
        if remainder == 1:
            lstrrev += "00"
        elif remainder == 2:
            lstrrev += "0"
        return lstrrev
    
    def _extract_thousands_groups(self, lstrrev):
        count = len(lstrrev) // 3
        a = [self.SUFFIX_EMPTY] * max(count, 1)
        for i in range(count):
            group = lstrrev[3 * i:3 * i + 3][::-1]
            a[i] = group
        return a
    
    def _format_thousands(self, a):
        lm = self.SUFFIX_EMPTY
        for i in range(len(a)):
            if a[i] != self.ZERO00:
                lm = self.trans_three(a[i]) + self.SPACE + self.parse_more(i) + self.SPACE + lm
            else:
                lm += self.trans_three(a[i])
        return lm
    
    def _format_cents(self, rstr):
        if rstr:
            return f"{self.AND_CENTS} {self.trans_two(rstr)} {self.SPACE}"
        return self.SUFFIX_EMPTY
    
    def format_with_cents(self, lm_stripped, xs):
        return f"{lm_stripped} {xs}{self.ONLY}"
    
    def trans_two(self, s):
        s = s.zfill(2)
        first_digit = int(s[0])
        last_digit = int(s[-1])
        if first_digit == 0:
            return self.NUMBER_WORDS[last_digit]
        elif first_digit == 1:
            teen_index = int(s) - 10
            return self.NUMBER_TEEN_WORDS[teen_index]
        elif s[1] == self.ZERO_SINGLE:
            return self.NUMBER_TEN_WORDS[first_digit - 1]
        else:
            return self.NUMBER_TEN_WORDS[first_digit - 1] + self.SPACE + self.NUMBER_WORDS[last_digit]
    
    def trans_three(self, s):
        first_digit = int(s[0])
        last_two = s[1:]
        if s[0] == self.ZERO_SINGLE:
            return self.trans_two(last_two)
        elif last_two == self.ZERO0:
            return f"{self.NUMBER_WORDS[first_digit]} {self.HUNDRED}"
        else:
            return f"{self.NUMBER_WORDS[first_digit]} {self.HUNDRED} {self.AND} {self.trans_two(last_two)}"
    
    def parse_more(self, i):
        return self.NUMBER_MORE_WORDS[i]
